name: Callsign
feature_notes: Admiral Office and Fleet Watchtower ask for the Admiral email before showing a password field. A changed username requires fresh confirmation.

backend_prerequisite.reason: Existing Countercraft backend is active; this build requires idle-v1 service and SQL upgrade before customer kiosk use. No Ike publication configured at read-only audit. Old service is rejected by kiosk.

install_step: After the passage PIN, confirm the Admiral email and check that the password field appears for that account.
